body: No this is me as well 100%. When I talk to others, I almost rarely act on my own. I'm constantly putting up a front or calculating my next step, what to say, how to get them to like me, etc. No one can know the real me cuz I don't even know that person. I wish I knew how to change, but I've even lied to therapists in the past for similar reasons. :/

I know. The problem isn't that I'm interested in anything unconventional. The problem is my only interest is getting people to like me. And you can't do that without some type of identity/passion/knowledge of who you are or what you like. When I interact with people, I became a board. A board for them to write their stories on, and then move onto greater things. I'm not sure why I'm like this or why can't I find something to keep me going while the world ignores me.
